_about: Worked examples from historical/technical sources, usable as animation scripts and as test cases for an emulator.

brevis_descriptio_multiplication.source: Leibniz 1710 Brevis descriptio, as quoted by Leupold 1727 (Jordan 1897 pp. 294-295)
brevis_descriptio_multiplication.setup: Clear result windows to 0. Set 1709 on the 4 rightmost small dials. Align carriage so units drum is under units result window.

steps.action: turn Magna Rota until pin hits stop (5 crank turns)
shift carriage one place left, turn until stop (6 turns)
shift carriage one more place, turn until stop (3 turns)

two_phase_carry_addition.task: 0448 + 0254 (first addend already in result register, second set on drums)

phase1_parallel_steps._note: Each step = one rib pitch (22.5 deg). Column values may exceed 9; the excess is the stored carry (Fünfhorn position).

phase2_serial_carries._note: Lowest digit first; in step 2 a secondary carry arises in the 10^1 column (9 -> 10).

burkhardt_timing_budget.claim: 9+1 carry needs 315 + 57.5 = 372.5 deg > 360 deg, so 'the machine can never have worked'
burkhardt_timing_budget.refutation: Lehmann: carry needs only ~10 deg thanks to detent springs; phases independent (Ludwig 2006).
